pins.definition: A person you work with in the same company or profession.
A person that you work with.
A person who works at the same workplace, especially one of similar rank.

situation: Two architects stand side by side at a large shared drafting table in a bright studio, pointing at the same blueprint.
subject: two people working side by side
brief: Two adults in work clothes stand closely side by side at a wide wooden table covered in architectural drawings, both pointing to the same pencil line on a large blue blueprint spread flat between them.
prompt: Two adults in work clothes stand closely side by side at a wide wooden table covered in architectural drawings, both pointing to the same pencil line on a large blue blueprint spread flat between them. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
